content:
maria: CI started failing on macOS after the toolchain roll, seeing link/cc1plus errors in a few targets.

maria: Error snippet:```/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redwood/13/cc1plus: warning: unrecognized command line option '-fno-merge-constants'
/usr/bin/ld: //third_party/foo/libfoo.a(foo.o): relocation R_X86_64_32S against '.rodata' can not be used when making a shared object; recompile with -fPIC
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status```

maria: full build: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345 (macos-13)

kenji: @maria can you paste the compile command above the error? looks like PIC/link flags issue or an ABI change in gcc13.

maria: compile line: `g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -fno-exceptions -Ithird_party/foo/include -c foo.cc -o foo.o` then link as `g++ -shared -o libbar.dylib foo.o -L... -lfoo` and we get multiple definition / relocation errors.

ci-bot: Build 12345 failed on macos-13 · job 7 · see logs · :warning:

lisa: my guess: third_party/foo was prebuilt without -fPIC and the new gcc image tightened defaults (or changed merging). Two quick options: add -fPIC to that cc_library or rebuild the static lib with PIC.

kenji: can someone bisect the toolchain image roll? suspect the image bump (gcc-12 -> gcc-13) is the trigger. @noah want to take it?

noah: I'll take the bisect. quick local repro created (tiny repro that links static foo into shared lib) — reproduces with the new toolchain image.

maria: can you also try CI with ccache disabled? `BAZEL_NOCCACHE=1 bazel build //...` or `bazel clean --expunge` — ccache sometimes hides stale object flags.

noah: re-ran with expunge and ccache disabled, same result. Added `-fPIC` to //third_party/foo:bar and built locally — link succeeded.

maria: opened PR 4567: add -fPIC to //third_party/foo:bar and pin the toolchain image in CI as a temporary mitigation. CI rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12347

kenji: nice catch. if PR fixes macOS we should backport to release branch and keep the toolchain pin until infra finishes the rollout.

lisa: :thumbsup: please hold merging to main until SRE confirms there's no perf/regression impact from the new flags.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered for PR 4567 · build 12347 · macos-13

maria: thanks everyone — will follow up after SRE signoff and the bisect. /cc @platform-team

noah: bisect confirms culprit: image roll at sha abcdef -> added gcc-13 with changed default behavior. filing infra ticket to coordinate a gradual rollout.
